## Why (verified evidence)

`_format_deltas` in `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:746-752` formats only `records[0]` per variant. `_compute_metrics` in `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py:1848-1856` stores up to five movers per variant in `top_changes_per_variant`. Operators asking chat to show deltas see a single mover even when the manifest lists five ranked changes.

Reproduction on tip `1f72351`: three movers `BigMover/Second/Third` → output contains only `BigMover notional_change=500`.

## Scope

Align chat delta summaries with manifest mover cardinality (up to five per variant).

## Tasks

- [ ] In `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:736-754`, iterate all records per variant (cap at five to match manifest) when building delta summary lines in `_format_deltas`.
- [ ] Add `tests/test_chat_session.py::test_format_deltas_lists_multiple_movers_per_variant` with three ranked records for one variant.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Named test: `pytest tests/test_chat_session.py::test_format_deltas_lists_multiple_movers_per_variant -q` passes.
- Deliberate-break → revert: restore single-record formatting using only `records[0]` in `src/counter_risk/chat/session.py:746` → confirm `test_format_deltas_lists_multiple_movers_per_variant` FAILS → revert → passes.

## Non-Goals

- Do NOT change manifest serialization in `src/counter_risk/pipeline/run.py:1848-1856`.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: listing only two movers when three are provided is a failure of this issue.

## Implementation Notes

`tests/test_chat_session.py` fixtures use a single mover per variant, which masked this gap.

_Surfaced by Track D audit 2026-09-21; verified by live repro on tip `1f72351`._
title: [P2] Chat _format_deltas surfaces only first manifest mover per variant
